kernel_pdeathsig.mechanism: Child storage daemons receive immediate kernel-directed SIGKILL upon abnormal launcher termination.

pid_reuse_toctou_defense.vulnerability_mitigated: TOCTOU race hazard where a dead FSP daemon PID is recycled by the OS for an unrelated process before cleanup kill()

implementation_layers.details: Launcher records /proc/{pid}/stat field 22 (starttime) in cluster.pids alongside PID. If PID is recycled, starttime mismatches and cleanup skips the PID.

cleanup_orphans invokes SYS_pidfd_open (syscall 434) to pin the exact kernel task struct, re-verifies command line, and issues SYS_pidfd_send_signal (syscall 424) with SIGKILL. Guarantees signals are never delivered to a recycled task.
is_fsp_process audits /proc/{pid}/cmdline and /proc/{pid}/comm to ensure target contains 'fsp-node' or 'fsp'.
